title: Robot Learning from Demonstration
summary: Robot learns new skills by watching human demonstration (imitation learning)
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Robot learns new skills by watching human demonstration (imitation learning).

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 56 independent sources on this technology.
